side_effect_policy: Probes may inspect versions, help, health, configuration resolution, and workspace registration. They must not create agent sessions, mutate product files, call models, or access hidden task artifacts.
pass_rule: Every required probe for the selected adapter must pass. A missing probe is a failure, not an implicit pass.
output_policy: Store command, exit code, status, timestamp, and output hash. Redact credentials and publish only bounded previews.
